verdict.rationale: Adyen's own docs list payment links as an offering, and its MCP tooling can create, get, and expire payment links. However, nothing in the pack shows a founder creating a shareable link from the Customer Area dashboard with no code; the documented creation path is programmatic. Community reports of volume minimums and refusals of small clients also cast doubt on 'start selling immediately', though they do not concretely contradict the payment-link feature itself. Missing for 10: documented no-code link creation in the Customer Area dashboard, evidence of shareable link configuration and flow, evidence of immediate go-live for a new founder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately
